scope: Read-only native static proof for the supplied graph FP32 Conv/DW parameter storage, weight layout, bias order and fused activation. No native execution or full inference comparison.

weight_layout.spatial_axis_limit: The supplied graph has only square kernels, equal strides and symmetric padding. Static index proof is [O,K0,K1,I] / [K0,K1,C]. A universal naming claim for asymmetric non-square K0/K1 is outside this bounded audit; no such case exists in this pinned graph.

serialization.order: All weights of one Conv/DW layer, then outChannels bias values when field9!=0, then next weighted layer. Not interleaved per output channel.
evidence: 0x106968–0x106998 computes weight count and source byte length via0x10153c
0x1069a0–0x1069b8 sets bias source=weight_start+weight_bytes; raw bias memcpy0x106a4c–0x106a60
0x106be0–0x106c68 computes next-layer consumed bytes as weight byte length plus optional bias byte length
Plain FP32 size branch0x100e30 returns count*dtype_width, here width4

limitations: No weight/model payloads or full graph included in this report; original model and LOCAL_ONLY graph remain private local inputs.
Static native layout proof does not establish bitwise agreement between ONNX CPU and ByteNN vectorized FMA/Winograd paths.
FP32 model parameters and FP32 host execution do not prove image HDR preservation, Android integration, correct face preprocessing/postprocessing, or completed full style replication.

Optimized Conv/DW engine selection varies by shape; this audit uses concrete generic FP32 pack and scalar DW code as decisive raw-storage contracts, without claiming every optimized numerical rounding path has been reproduced.
